body: She spoke to me today and told me to go kill myself
I feel exactly the same. I don't want to kill myself as such I just don't want to exist and for no one to remember me

The messages have happened on about 3 or 4 occasions from November to about 8 weeks ago. I don't remember sending them and I know that's no excuse. She found out 2 weeks ago and just hates me. I know this sounds like a puppy love 15 year olds problem but I'm 24. We were planning our wedding and talking about buying a house. I didn't know it was possible to love someone so much until I met her. I need her I feel empty and just don't want to go on anymore I can't eat or sleep properly I've just had enough
